Acquisition is unconditional and subexponential for r=o(n),rM=o(n^2). With the local-phase theorem, log(2+(m+M)/n)=o(log n) gives original-input subexponential exact counting.

results.statement: An irreducible symmetric SPD M-matrix A is exactly reconstructed from n(n+1)/2 labeled scalar port responses to baseline, single shunts t/2t and pair shunts t, t>0. card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
An irreducible symmetric SPD M-matrix A is exactly reconstructed from n(n+1)/2 labeled scalar port responses to baseline, single shunts t/2t and pair shunts t, t>0. The inverse-M inequalities uniquely select the pair root. For K+sC with unknown positive internal shunt gains h_i, independently known diagonal C and two distinct positive real Laplace points identify all gains and K using n(n+1) scalar responses. Unknown C preserves the congruence ambiguity.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Known node count/labels and calibrated positive shunts for finite tomography; exact responses and connected SPD M-matrix. Self-calibration additionally needs independent absolute capacities, common known source/port calibration, h_0=1 and exact positive-real Laplace responses. These are not two sinusoidal frequencies.

BOUNDARIES
Exact real identifiability/count optimality does not imply robust physical recovery. Positive diagonal shunts cannot remove the hidden-loss depth barrier under the specified readout model. The stronger transient all-signed-input bound charges squared input, not physical work. Unequal-variance extension compares Gaussian KL, not Blackwell order. All8 noisy direct calibrations rejected or left the physical class; ordinary constrained joint fitting was stronger but small port error did not identify internal parameters. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay interventions, calibration, settling, finite pulse tail and reset cycles. Tail bias <=Q exp(-sT)/(s C_0 U(s)), variance sigma²(1-exp(-2sT))/(2s U(s)²); longer horizon leaves nonzero noise variance. Inverse conditioning/depth can amplify tiny errors. Full waveforms may be more informative than two summaries.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire calibrated internal access or independent capacities and useful parameter-error bounds; validate noise/reset/physical work and compare full-data incumbents before claiming specimen identification.

results.title: Acquire a hidden field and quadratic defect to count raw Boolean cubics exactly
results.statement: For raw Boolean cubic p on n=bd bits with radical-free third tensor and centroid field F_(2^d), acquire its field/module coordinates and Frobenius-band quadratic base plus actual polar-rank defect r. For s>=1,2s<d and2r<=d-2s-1, exact counting has bit time2^[r+O(b(log(n+2)+s))]poly(L+n). At s=1 and fixed b this is2^r poly(L+n) with polynomial space. The theorem is independent of the pinned ETH manuscript.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
For raw Boolean cubic p on n=bd bits with radical-free third tensor and centroid field F_(2^d), acquire its field/module coordinates and Frobenius-band quadratic base plus actual polar-rank defect r. For s>=1,2s<d and2r<=d-2s-1, exact counting has bit time2^[r+O(b(log(n+2)+s))]poly(L+n). At s=1 and fixed b this is2^r poly(L+n) with polynomial space. The theorem is independent of the pinned ETH manuscript.

INTERFACE
Exact raw degree<=3 ANF, or an accepted exact term-budget gate compilation. The useful low-degree model must be over the acquired centroid field. No field, basis, defect, base polynomial or code is supplied. The general evaluator is the established Lauder-Wan algorithm; the delivered complete backend is the narrower three-field-coordinate product-cubic family at bandwidth1.

BOUNDARIES
Global polar-defect rank is not symmetric-completion rank. Proper-subfield low degree need not transfer to the centroid field. The general point counter is not implemented here; polynomial space is not inferred for growing b or unrestricted s. Arbitrary prefix restrictions, generic SAT/inversion, and beyond-radius unique recovery do not follow.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Manufactured field and rank-code decoding are polynomial-time. Recover ordinary field degree Ds=2^s+1, then stream2^r real Walsh leaves; exact accumulatorO(n+r) bits. General space has2^O(b(log n+s)) contribution. The actual finite Dwork triple backend avoids field enumeration but is not a benchmark; all gate ANF product/term-budget costs are charged.

PROOF SPINE
Third tensor acquires the field, trace pairing manufactures Gabidulin block codes, left-annihilator decoding recovers the base and defect. Restore diagonal/unary and trace-one constant corrections. Real Walsh leaves reduce to Artin-Schreier point counts. The specialized triple backend acquires factors and evaluates Kloosterman sums by finite Dwork trace.

INTERNAL REVIEW
Completed source-exposed internal review of the exact governing proof and identified internal audits. Acceptance is confined to the stated mathematical interface and dependencies; no external review prerequisite.

EXECUTION AND EVIDENCE
No generic SAT/circuit counter, practical speed advantage, measured device or historical-priority claim. Saved finite executions are producer evidence, not an intake replay. The general replacement engine is not implemented in the phase packages.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Keep exact source conditions, acquired representations, arithmetic and runtime dimensions. General-family extensions and equally informed performance comparisons need their own evidence.

A separate shared-probe route can instead acquire a small faithful operator algebra when closure fits its dimension budget. Unsupported or non-unique cases remain UNKNOWN; full rank in the tested quadratic library excludes only a nonzero rank-one law in that library.

EXACT CLAIM
For a fixed finite-dimensional exact-rational linear interface exposing vector and transpose actions for A and B, a declared bounded word/rank/degree search can acquire a relation such as AB=q BA+cI+UV^T, then retain its defect factors and degree-filtered left/right modules. Conditional on that accepted identity, the retained representation produces exact corrections for later bounded-degree word and polynomial programs and computes their validity domains without new native acquisition calls. A separate shared-probe route can instead acquire a small faithful operator algebra when closure fits its dimension budget. Unsupported or non-unique cases remain UNKNOWN; full rank in the tested quadratic library excludes only a nonzero rank-one law in that library.

METHOD
1. Query exact vector and transpose actions under the supplied fixed linear-map contract and declared word/rank budget.
2. Recover a scalar and low-rank residual candidate, or linearize the rank-one condition over the fixed library (I,A,B,A^2,AB,BA,B^2). A one-dimensional decomposable minor-kernel gives uniqueness only within that library; fresh native checks separately test existence.
3. Factor the residual R=UV^T and acquire degree-filtered left/right modules. Their row space gives the maximal common protected domain for bounded-degree uses of the ideal law.
4. Normalize later words to ideal normal forms plus retained defect corrections. New bounded-degree procedures can be synthesized with no further native acquisition calls; corrected execution remains all-input conditional on the accepted law. If a small closure is acquired instead, checked multiplication tables represent all finite polynomial programs in those same primitives.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
The n=64 degree-eight differentiation control acquired sigma=1, c=7/3 and rank-one defect in 68 primitive actions versus 128 for dense tomography; its common protected domain has dimension 57. The unlabelled q=2, degree-five example synthesized with zero new native calls and executed in four B actions versus twelve direct actions, after 96 acquisition actions versus 64 for tomography. card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
A raw radical-free cubic acquires primitive blocks, unknown local bases and a response-type profile. In the stated adversarial model the exact identity p(Ay)=q_off(UHU^T)(y)+q_Sprime(y)+f(y) has rank<=R and at most15 beta^2(2E+n) residual edges. Acquisition is unconditional. Conditional counting and exact optimal prediction within acquired modulo-four summaries are subexponential for beta=n^o(1),R=o(n),log(2+E/n)=o(log n).

INTERFACE
Raw exact Boolean ANF; radical-free top tensor and its acquired primitive blocks. Hidden repeated types are shared only across equal-size blocks; E is the sum of off-block error ranks. Bases, type profile, quotient and errors are not supplied. f remains block-local after full substitution.

BOUNDARIES
This structured response model is not every low-rank model. Number of disjoint indicator classes, not only matrix rank, governs synthesis. Higher-degree extensions explicitly test all lower nonlinear cross-block terms. Feature-class optimality is not unrestricted learning or compression.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Acquisition2^O(beta^2)poly(L+n), polynomial space. Counting uses2^(R+F(n,m0+15 beta^2(2E+n)+O(n))),m0=O(n beta^2). Streaming synthesis costs2^(4R+F(...)), writes up to4^R rows, and reconstructs inner sums before division. Original program front end charges O(S n^6) coefficient work when every intermediate remains cubic.

PROOF SPINE
Centroid idempotents reveal blocks. Sum-rank orbit distances survive unknown gauges; metric medoids plus budget DP acquire the profile. Symmetric majority rounding retains every discrepancy. Mod4 class populations and exact character sums yield per-fiber labels and minimum uniform-input mistakes.

INTERNAL REVIEW
Completed source-exposed internal review of the exact governing proof and identified internal audits. Acceptance is confined to the stated mathematical interface and dependencies; no external review prerequisite.

EXECUTION AND EVIDENCE
No generic SAT/circuit counter, practical speed advantage, measured device or historical-priority claim. Saved finite executions are producer evidence, not an intake replay. The general replacement engine is not implemented in the phase packages.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Keep exact source conditions, acquired representations, arithmetic and runtime dimensions. General-family extensions and equally informed performance comparisons need their own evidence.

results.title: Acquire a hidden field and quadratic defect to count raw Boolean cubics exactly
results.statement: For raw Boolean cubic p on n=bd bits with radical-free third tensor and centroid field F_(2^d), acquire its field/module coordinates and Frobenius-band quadratic base plus actual polar-rank defect r. For s>=1,2s<d and2r<=d-2s-1, exact counting has bit time2^[r+O(b(log(n+2)+s))]poly(L+n). At s=1 and fixed b this is2^r poly(L+n) with polynomial space. The theorem is independent of the pinned ETH manuscript.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
For raw Boolean cubic p on n=bd bits with radical-free third tensor and centroid field F_(2^d), acquire its field/module coordinates and Frobenius-band quadratic base plus actual polar-rank defect r. For s>=1,2s<d and2r<=d-2s-1, exact counting has bit time2^[r+O(b(log(n+2)+s))]poly(L+n). At s=1 and fixed b this is2^r poly(L+n) with polynomial space. The theorem is independent of the pinned ETH manuscript.

INTERFACE
Exact raw degree<=3 ANF, or an accepted exact term-budget gate compilation. The useful low-degree model must be over the acquired centroid field. No field, basis, defect, base polynomial or code is supplied. The general evaluator is the established Lauder-Wan algorithm; the delivered complete backend is the narrower three-field-coordinate product-cubic family at bandwidth1.

BOUNDARIES
Global polar-defect rank is not symmetric-completion rank. Proper-subfield low degree need not transfer to the centroid field. The general point counter is not implemented here; polynomial space is not inferred for growing b or unrestricted s. Arbitrary prefix restrictions, generic SAT/inversion, and beyond-radius unique recovery do not follow.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Manufactured field and rank-code decoding are polynomial-time. Recover ordinary field degree Ds=2^s+1, then stream2^r real Walsh leaves; exact accumulatorO(n+r) bits. General space has2^O(b(log n+s)) contribution. The actual finite Dwork triple backend avoids field enumeration but is not a benchmark; all gate ANF product/term-budget costs are charged.

PROOF SPINE
Third tensor acquires the field, trace pairing manufactures Gabidulin block codes, left-annihilator decoding recovers the base and defect. Restore diagonal/unary and trace-one constant corrections. Real Walsh leaves reduce to Artin-Schreier point counts. The specialized triple backend acquires factors and evaluates Kloosterman sums by finite Dwork trace.

INTERNAL REVIEW
Completed source-exposed internal review of the exact governing proof and identified internal audits. Acceptance is confined to the stated mathematical interface and dependencies; no external review prerequisite.

EXECUTION AND EVIDENCE
No generic SAT/circuit counter, practical speed advantage, measured device or historical-priority claim. Saved finite executions are producer evidence, not an intake replay. The general replacement engine is not implemented in the phase packages.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Keep exact source conditions, acquired representations, arithmetic and runtime dimensions. General-family extensions and equally informed performance comparisons need their own evidence.

Target is the particular pure vector psi0=P0|+>/||P0|+>|| even for degenerate ground spaces. Positive boundary contraction yields energy <=E0+xi at tau=O(n/xi) without a gap.
